dialogue.speaker: Mei
dialogue.text: 早上好，感谢您来参加面试。
dialogue.en: Good morning, and thank you for coming to the interview.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Good morning. Thank you for inviting me.

dialogue.speaker: Mei
dialogue.text: 请简单介绍一下您自己和您的经验。
dialogue.en: Please tell me a little about yourself and your experience.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: 我学的是商科，已经在市场部门工作三年了。
dialogue.en: I studied business, and I have worked in marketing for three years.

dialogue.speaker: Mei
dialogue.text: 很有意思。您为什么应聘这个职位？
dialogue.en: Interesting. Why did you apply for this position?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: 我喜欢贵公司的项目，也想在更大的团队里学习。
dialogue.en: I like your company's projects, and I want to learn in a bigger team.

dialogue.speaker: Mei
dialogue.text: 您觉得自己最大的优点是什么？
dialogue.en: What would you say is your greatest strength?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: 我做事有条理，而且有压力的时候也能保持冷静。
dialogue.en: I am organized, and I stay calm when there is pressure.

dialogue.speaker: Mei
dialogue.text: 您喜欢一个人工作，还是在团队里工作？
dialogue.en: Do you prefer working alone or as part of a team?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: 两种我都喜欢，但我在团队里表现最好。
dialogue.en: I enjoy both, but I do my best work in a team.

dialogue.speaker: Mei
dialogue.text: 好的。我们下周会联系您。您还有什么问题吗？
dialogue.en: Good. We will contact you next week. Do you have any questions?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: 有，能请您介绍一下薪水和工作时间吗？
dialogue.en: Yes, could you tell me about the salary and the working hours?
